title: Design System: PayDay

display.purpose: The single page heading on the headland.

headline.purpose: The one sentence under the heading, held to 30ch.

body.purpose: Table cells, facts, labels, capsule text.

label.purpose: Column heads, relative dates, hints, tags.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Easing for the chip slide; overshoots slightly.

motion.name: chip-slide
motion.purpose: Chip moves 4px in its direction of travel on hover and focus; 1px and scale 0.92 on press. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: row-wash
motion.purpose: Table row hover wash. Off under reduced motion.

components.name: Capsule
components.description: The primary action on a screen: sun fill, trailing ink chip that slides on hover.
components.css: .ds-cap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sun, #F5E211); color: var(--ink, #2C2E2A); font: 500 1.0625rem/1.2 "Bricolage Grotesque", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cap .ds-chip { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #2C2E2A); color: var(--sun, #F5E211); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-cap:hover .ds-chip, .ds-cap:focus-visible .ds-chip { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-cap:active .ds-chip { transform: translateX(1px) scale(0.92); } .ds-cap svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-cap:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2C2E2A); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cap .ds-chip { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
PayDay is drawn like the fold-out map handed over at a garden gate: cream water, one green headland, and a handful of flat-colour markers that say where to go next. The system grew from the catalog world Gardens Guide Map (`aww2-zoo-gardens-guide-map`). Every page, signed in or out, opens on the headland, a single organic green lobe whose coast leaves the frame at the top and left. The page heading and one plain sentence sit on that land; the working data sits below it on white sheets.

Colour is flat. There are no gradients, no shadows, and no textures. Hierarchy comes from size alone, because the one typeface is set at one weight throughout. Controls are capsules, and the ones that act carry a round ink chip that slides on hover with a small overshoot. That slide is the system's only motion gesture.

Density is that of a working tool: tables and definition lists, generous row height, no cards inside cards, no metric tiles.
keyCharacteristics: One green headland per page, carrying the heading and a single sentence.
Flat colour only; depth is stated by ground colour (cream, green, white).
One grotesk, one weight (500); scale does all the hierarchy work.
Capsule controls with a round ink chip on the travelling edge.
White sheets with a 22px corner hold tables, facts, and forms.
Numbers are tabular everywhere money or dates appear.

rules.name: The Flag Rule
rules.body: Coral flags exceptions only: count tags on the Overdue and failed-reminder sections, an "Overdue" tag and a "Failed" tag on the invoice page. Open, Paid, and Archived status are plain words in Ink. There are no per-row status pills; a table row that is late is already under an Overdue heading.

rules.name: The Ink On Colour Rule
rules.body: Text on any marker colour, on the land, and on the sun is always Ink. Marker colours are fills; they are never used as text colours.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each marker colour holds one job: sun acts, land settles, sky edits, lilac archives, coral warns. A new action picks the nearest existing meaning before a new colour is added.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Everything is weight 500. Headings, `strong`, and table heads are reset to 500 and font synthesis is off. Emphasis is made with size or with Ink versus Ink 2, never with bold or italics.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any element showing money or dates uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Map Rule
rules.body: A surface is distinguished by its fill colour and its corner, never by a shadow, blur, or gradient. Hover and focus change colour or position; they do not lift.

dos: Do open every page on a headland with one Display heading and one Headline sentence, then leave 120px of cream before the working content.
Do make every control a capsule at 44px minimum height; give forward actions a trailing Ink chip and backward moves a leading one.
Do set all text at weight 500 in Bricolage Grotesque and build hierarchy from the five sizes in the ramp.
Do keep text on Sun, Land, Coral, Sky, and Lilac in Ink.
Do put tables, fact lists, and forms on a white sheet with a 22px corner.
Do use tabular figures for money and dates.
Do keep the chip slide as the only animated gesture and switch it off under reduced motion.
Do write status as plain Ink words and flag only exceptions (Overdue, Failed) with a Coral tag.
Do mark focus with the 3px Ink outline.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, blurs, or textures; a surface is its flat fill.
Don't introduce a second weight, an italic, or a second typeface.
Don't use a marker colour as text, or Ink 2 on anything but white or cream.
Don't nest a sheet inside a sheet or square off a corner.
Don't place more than one headland on a page or let it float clear of the top and left edges.
Don't give a marker colour a second meaning; coral stays for exceptions (overdue, failed) and delete.
Don't add per-row status pills or colour Open, Paid, or Archived.
